scope: Correction only, conditioned on captured native normalized hidden, native predecessor embeddings, positions and last context; every projection variant is paired against its unchanged original baseline on the same case.
limits: These substitutions intentionally depart from the original forward and cannot be counted as original-reference parity passes.
Only correction is evaluated; the backbone, target head, free-running proposals, target verification and serving speed are not measured here.
The original six-slot PyTorch batching is retained; native one-row GEMM algorithm choices are not reproduced.
All 24 correction input states are distinct. Fused/double group summaries are descriptive, not a matched normalization-only comparison.
These are captured draft passes from the chat and long tuning fixtures, not 24 independent model-quality samples or a held-out performance evaluation.
Reduction percentages are median per-case absolute-RMS error reductions, not explained-variance percentages or a guarantee of improved threshold pass counts.
Private paths, raw vectors, token IDs, capture/output tensor hashes and model-weight contents are excluded; report hashes retain an audit link to private evidence.
